trades.reasoning: GLXY shows all four confirming signals (RSI in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20 with a volume surge), the top score on the list and a textbook institutional-participation setup.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-up today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.2%), a neutral tape with no strong directional catalyst. With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, we added GLXY on full four-signal confirmation while holding all existing positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today with NASDAQ up 0.4% and the S&P 500 up 0.2%, a quiet session without a single dominant catalyst moving the market. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer signals before committing more capital. No major headline events were flagged in today's screen.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和向上,納指升0.4%,標普500升0.2%,屬於缺乏明顯主導消息的平淡交易日。投資者在更清晰的訊號出現前保持觀望,成交區間偏窄。今日篩選未見重大頭條事件。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting until several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price vs moving average, and volume — all point the same direction before acting. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when four line up together it's a much stronger sign that real buying interest (not just a random spike) is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號共振是指等待多個獨立技術指標(如RSI、MACD、股價相對於移動平均線、成交量)同時指向同一方向後才採取行動。單一利好訊號可能只是雜訊,但當四個訊號同時出現時,就更能反映真實的買盤力量,而非偶發的價格波動。
